chunks: Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah and a group with him, who said: We heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying:
The one who is after the Imam recognizes the knowledge of the one who was before him during the last moment remaining of his soul.

key_terms.آخِرِ دَقِيقَةٍ: the final moment or last instant
key_terms.الَّذِي بَعْدَ: the one who comes after, meaning the succeeding Imam
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.عِلْمَ: knowledge, specifically the transmitted knowledge of the Imam
key_terms.مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَهُ: the one who was before him, meaning the preceding Imam

ai.seo_question: When does the succeeding Imam come to know the knowledge of the previous Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the succeeding Imam receives recognition of the knowledge of the preceding Imam at the final moment of the latter's life. It indicates the continuity of divinely granted knowledge within the Imamate and the unbroken transmission of authority.
